Slayers Club Live | DOOM: The Dark Ages One Year Anniversary Stream | w/ Hugo Martin

Join us as DOOM: The Dark Ages' Game Director Hugo Martin celebrates the one year anniversary of DOOM: The Dark Ages by playing the Ripatorium 2.0 Community Custom Encounter, "Waltz of the Archdemons".

ARENA: Harbor of Souls 
13 Minute Timer 

The community lore around the custom encounter:
After the Slayer had found his next target after eliminating Prince Ahzrak and stopping his command over the horde, the Slayer found an entity far beyond Ahzrak himself. The highly guarded and acclaimed "Archdemons", the one he had heard about in Hell's scriptures and chants. An Archdemon seemed to be the logical next step in Hell
